adopted_complete_objects.title: Discovery and alternative activation
adopted_complete_objects.fact: Ordinary discovery scans PBS root *.txt only, matches exact base or base_ suffix after longest-base ordering. Gen5–8 subdirectories are author alternatives, not simultaneous or automatically active registries. Explicit facility Trainers/Pokemon paths bypass generic basename discovery. A copied backup remains subject to current schema, dependencies, code and settings; changing its directory name does not recompute loaded settings constants.

adopted_complete_objects.title: Lexical and schema collection
adopted_complete_objects.fact: First-line BOM removal, physical comment/blank skip and subsequent first-# suffix deletion precede ordinary attribute collection. A space followed by # within ordinary section becomes invalid empty attribute, unlike specialized prepped-line loops. Ordinary repeated attributes overwrite; ^ fields accumulate; valid unknown schema attributes are ignored. Fixed schema ignores excess tail, q consumes preprocessed original string. Escaped-quote marker removal is positional; ordinary CSV quotation is not a general unquote guarantee.

adopted_complete_objects.title: Registry identity and incomplete compile

Direct register replaces same key; ordinary compiler duplicate gate rejects before second registration. Clear and successful prefix registrations occur before whole-table validation/save. Failure does not itself undo earlier in-memory registrations.

adopted_complete_objects.title: Compile, save, startup reload and failure

Compiler.main is debug-gated, uses missing required data/full flag/CTRL/import and integer-second maximum text>=maximum data time trigger; deletes listed data before full stage if triggered. Types→abilities→moves→items precede dependent species/trainers/facilities. Direct full-content entry lacks startup discovery decision/predelete/rescue. Reset/SystemExit rethrow; other diagnosed failures attempt listed deletion, not guaranteed transaction. Successful stage saves table/message outputs; ordinary startup GameData.load_all replaces registries. No Ruby/serialized load was run here.

adopted_complete_objects.title: Existing objects and save-game reload
adopted_complete_objects.fact: Game.load(save_data) applies saved values/maps rather than recompiling or calling GameData.load_all. Pokemon::Move holds ID/PP/PPUp but queries data fields and totalPP live by ID. Battle::Move snapshots name/function/power/type/category/accuracy/target/priority/effectChance and clones flags at construction; its totalPP may delegate to realMove unless positive explicit override. AIMove wraps this existing battle object, sets calcType and moldBreaker during setup and uses skill-dependent own handlers/callbacks. Registry reload cannot be generalized to refresh all existing battle snapshots, caches or old data instances.

facts.complete_units: SaveData_Value whole Value and register/compile definitions
facts.meaning: Registration validates symbol/block, constructs the complete Value first, and appends it. Duplicate IDs remain multiple registrations; compile loops in registration order, so every save callback runs and the later same-ID result overwrites the hash slot. unregister removes every matching registration.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: A failing constructor is not appended. A later save callback/validation failure prevents later callbacks and prevents save_to_file opening output; earlier callback side effects are not restored. Dynamic extra registration order remains external.

facts.meaning: A registration class check is Object.const_get(class_symbol) then is_a?, not nested object-graph validation. Save and load validate each object; load marks loaded only after its callback returns. valid?(hash) checks every registration including missing-key nil, whereas load_values uses a present key, otherwise its new-game proc when defined.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: No all-values preflight is performed by load_values. A later failure can leave earlier globals assigned and loaded flags true. Missing without new-game proc is skipped. A callback that mutates then raises is not marked loaded but its external mutation can remain. Unknown hash keys are not loaded by these loops.

facts.meaning: Default17 registration order is player, frame_count, game_system, pokemon_system, switches, variables, self_switches, game_screen, map_factory, game_player, global_metadata, map_metadata, bag, storage_system, essentials_version, game_version, stats. Exactly game_system, pokemon_system, essentials_version, game_version and stats are boot-loaded. Only stats is reset_on_new_game. map_factory has no new-game proc.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: This is the fixed built-in registration set before plugin overrides/additions; it is not the engine object-graph inventory. Constructor failures stop the sequential new-game/boot loop at their actual prefix.

facts.meaning: player saves/loads the Player object through $player; Player inherits Trainer party and initializes a Pokedex field. storage_system saves/loads $PokemonStorage as PokemonStorage. global_metadata uses $PokemonGlobal/PokemonGlobalMetadata, map_metadata uses $PokemonMap/PokemonMapMetadata, and bag uses $bag/PokemonBag. Party and Pokedex are not separate built-in top-level SaveData IDs.
